en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over the small town of Groitzsch. In the foreground are trees, garden plots and farm buildings; behind them a dense cluster of houses and, on the right, a large church with a tall tower and steep roof dominates the skyline. Industrial chimneys and a water tower are visible in the distant background. The image caption is printed in red German script at the top.
